For gamers who search for reliable and high efficiency power supply

Gamma series offers most reliable, efficient and most desirable design for high-end PC builders. LLC+DC to DC technology

Montech Gamma series provides high efficiency up to 90% and is certified to 80 PLUS® Gold. Also, the series has been optimized with all generations of Intel's and AMD's processors to maximize energy saving.

Efficiency

Gamma II can effectively save the energy consumption and guaranties a minimum of 90 % efficiency, producing less heat generation.

Powerful Single +12V Rail

Powerful single rail +12 V and DC-DC circuit provide a stable and reliable supply to Graphics Cards and other pc components.

120MM silent fan

High quality fan provides strong airflow with low noise, which makes low temperatures and quiet operation.

Fan RPM vs Load Shows silent operation and sufficient airflow.

Full Flat Cables

The new Gamma II series incoorporate the flat cables, which can increase the airflow and improve chassis thermal performance, also allowing for easy cable routing.

Cables

GAMMA II series offer sufficient amount of cables. Also, the length of the cables are longer which makes building easier.

Complete 5 Protections & 5 Years Warranty

A total of 5 protections, including OCP, OVP, UVP, OPP, SCP, make the Gamma II series a safe and reliable power supply. Gamma II series offer 5 year warranty since the date of purchase. This shows our confidence and the quality for this power supply.

Trustworthy Manufacturing, Dedicated to Outstanding Products.

Montech is committed to the development of PC gaming chassis, power supplies and cooling to the highest standards. Our designs and attention to quality is like none other. We strive to bring the best price to performance ratio to consumers.

POWER UP WITHOUT ANY NOISE

The Century series brings a premium power supply unit in 550, 650, 850 wattage. It offers 80 Plus Gold efficiency rating, full modular cables, premium FDB fan, 100% Japanese high-quality capacitors.

 And it features superior full bridge LLC resonant converter together with DC-DC circuitry, put this product on the mountain top for gold power supply.

HIGH EFFICIENCY AND LOWER OPERATING COSTS

Century series is certified 80 PLUS® Gold, it can effectively save energy consumption and guaranties a minimum of 90 % efficiency at 50% load, producing less heat generation. Also, the series has been optimized with all generations of Intel's processors to maximize energy saving.

MODERN CIRCUIT LAYOUT DELIVERS SUPERIOR PERFORMANCE

Century series uses a full bridge LLC resonant converter framework together with DC-DC circuity, plus 100% Japanese capacitors and all high- quality components.

 Making the Century Series power supply reliable for safety and stable voltage outputs, better performance and higher efficiency.

DURABLE AND SECURE

High Quality Components Century series adopts 100% Japanese industrial level electronic capacitors for high durability, also achieve tight voltage and low ripple noise to enhance performance. Moreover, it’s durable in high temperature and high pressure, therefore can effectively increase the lifespan of computer components.

SILENT OPERATION AND LONGER LIFESPAN

The advantage of using Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) in the fan is to enhance the impact absorbance effects of oil. It generates less noise and heat than most of the other bearing. And, it can effectively reduce friction and vibration due to the lubrication of the bearing surface. Therefore, more reliable performance and considerably longer lifespan.

USER FRIENDLY CABLING

Fully modular cable set allows users to only attach the cables they need, reducing cable clutter and increasing airflow.

Cables

The modular cables are longer than normal power supply, makes the cable management even easier.

Complete 6 Protections & 5 Years Warranty

The century series offers 5 year warranty. This shows our confidence and the quality of this power supply.
